# English–Persian Dictionary v3.1

> A free, offline English-to-Persian (Farsi) dictionary with 164,524 entries and 31,189 indexed inflected forms, packaged for e-readers: Kindle (.mobi), Kobo (dicthtml), KOReader, Onyx Boox, GoldenDict and other StarDict apps. It is a revision and expansion of English-Persian Dictionary v2.4 (H. Yazdani, published by hossein1376) and is released under the MIT licence. New and rewritten wording was produced by AI language models and has not been reviewed by a human Persian editor.

Key facts: 164,524 entries (v2.4 had 145,075, v3.0 had 154,439); 21,578 new entries (10,085 of them in v3.1); 3,589 subject senses added to existing words in v3.1; 7,016 high-frequency definitions rewritten; Persian orthography normalised in 106,983 entries; 3,120 misspelled headwords corrected; 2,128 duplicates merged; 31,189 inflected forms indexed (looking up "walked" opens "walk"). Section counts include Computing 5,399, Business & economics 4,335, Informal & slang 2,456, Medicine 1,633, Geography 1,210. Twelve sections were added in v3.1: Philosophy & logic 1,181, Arts 865, Earth & environmental sciences 753, Transport & logistics 719, Agriculture & veterinary 706, History & archaeology 542, Sociology & anthropology 525, Literature 520, Fashion & textiles 497, Education 485, Statistics 393, Media & communication 376. Direction: English headword to Persian definition. Works offline.

Known limits: not verified screen by screen on every e-reader generation; about 107,000 specialised entries received only mechanical repairs and keep their 1990s wording; AI-written entries are unreviewed by a human Persian editor; no PocketBook-native .dic build (use KOReader with the StarDict files).

## Download
- [Kindle .mobi, classic (words stored in visual order, like v2.4)](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/dist/kindle/English-Persian.Dictionary.v3.1-classic.mobi): copy to documents/dictionaries/ on the Kindle; try this first
- [Kindle .mobi, right-to-left (natural reading order)](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/dist/kindle/English-Persian.Dictionary.v3.1-rtl.mobi): for Kindle apps/firmware that handle bidirectional text, or if the classic build shows sentences reversed
- [Kobo dicthtml zip](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/dist/kobo/dicthtml-en-fa.zip): copy to .kobo/custom-dict/ (firmware 4.24+)
- [StarDict zip (HTML definitions)](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/dist/stardict/English-Persian-v3.1-stardict.zip): KOReader (koreader/data/dict/), Onyx Boox, GoldenDict, Moon+ Reader
- [StarDict zip (plain text)](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/dist/stardict/English-Persian-v3.1-stardict-plaintext.zip): for readers that print HTML tags as text
- [Master TSV, all entries](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/raw/main/data/English-Persian.v3.1.tsv): headword, definition, sections, status, alternate forms

## Documentation
- [README](https://github.com/shahabahreini/English-Persian-Dictionary/blob/main/README.md): install steps per device, what changed, limits, FAQ
- [Landing page (English)](https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/): downloads and FAQ
- [Landing page (Persian)](https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/fa/): دانلود و آموزش نصب به فارسی
- [Change report](https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/report.html): every new, rewritten and corrected entry beside its v2.4 text, with counts per subject section
- [Full text for LLMs](https://shahabahreini.github.io/English-Persian-Dictionary/llms-full.txt): all of the above in one plain-text file
